change.after: "returns the results of the most recent cached probe"

exposure.needed: whether operators or scripts invoke `cilium-health status --probe` and rely on it running a synchronous probe rather than returning cached results

consequence.statement: `cilium-health status --probe` still runs but no longer performs a synchronous probe. It returns the results of the most recent cached probe instead. The option is hidden and will be removed in a future release.
consequence.remediation: Check any scripts or health checks that call `cilium-health status --probe` and expect a fresh synchronous probe. Make sure cached results are acceptable, and plan to stop using the flag before it is removed.
